name: To Kill A Black Swan
source: A short murder mystery visual novel about a detective, a yoga course attendant, a grieving wife, a cleaner, a “bro”, and a bitchy friend. To Kill A Black Swan is not your average whodunit, nothing is as it seems to be, it is all about superficiality (and beneath the surface it has an important message to tell.) TKABS was created for the 2014 Indie Game Development Contest and is available for free. The title is inspired by To Kill A Mockingbird by Harper Lee, but it is an original story.
translation: 一部关于侦探、瑜伽课程接待员、悲伤的妻子、清洁工、“兄弟”和刻薄朋友的短篇谋杀悬疑视觉小说。《杀死一只黑天鹅》不是普通的推理故事，一切都不像表面看起来那样，主题在于表象（而表象之下隐藏着重要信息）。本作是为2014年独立游戏开发大赛制作的免费作品。标题受到哈珀·李《杀死一只知更鸟》的启发，但故事完全原创。
